name: Data table
description: Readable table with a caption, scoped headers, right-aligned numbers and status badges. Scrolls sideways on small screens.
notes: Right-align numbers and use tabular figures so digits line up. A <caption> names the table for screen-reader users.
checked: axe clean in light and dark; tightest text contrast 4.79:1 (needs 4.5:1); 1 tab stop; fits a phone in RTL with Arabic: yes; with 40% longer text: yes; contrast holds with a fitted brand: yes

receipt.tree:
- region "Recent invoices":
  - table "Recent invoices":
    - caption: Recent invoices
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Invoice Customer Status Amount":
        - columnheader "Invoice"
        - columnheader "Customer"
        - columnheader "Status"
        - columnheader "Amount"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "#1042 Northwind Traders Paid $1,200.00":
        - cell "#1042"
        - cell "Northwind Traders"
        - cell "Paid"
        - cell "$1,200.00"
      - row "#1041 Globex Corp Due $860.50":
        - cell "#1041"
        - cell "Globex Corp"
        - cell "Due"
        - cell "$860.50"
      - row "#1040 Initech Overdue $3,075.00":
        - cell "#1040"
        - cell "Initech"
        - cell "Overdue"
        - cell "$3,075.00"
